last_assistant_message:
**[Rigby]: Build's done, but I had to clean up after the crew before signing off on it. Report below.**

**What got built (verified, holds up):**

- `.claude/hooks/eval-turn-start.py` (new, `UserPromptSubmit`) — detects when a prompt is asking Master to run a master-owned workflow (boot, shutdown-cleanup, weekly-review — the three that execute inline and never get a `SubagentStart`/`SubagentStop` pair) and opens an eval record with `monitoring.state_yaml_path` pointing at that workflow's `state.yaml`.
- `.claude/hooks/eval-turn-stop.py` (new, `Stop`) — closes the record only once `state.yaml` hits a terminal status; leaves it open across turns for anything still running; does nothing if no record was opened. No stubs, no partial records.
- `.claude/hooks/eval-agent-start.py` / `eval-agent-stop.py` — extended (not rewritten) to link any subagent spawned while a turn-level record is open into its new `subagents[]` array with model/tokens/cost/duration, without touching their existing standalone-record behavior.
- `systems/eval-harness/hook_utils.py` (new) — shared `atomic_write_json`, session-id inference, and record-lookup helpers so the new hooks don't duplicate logic.
- `systems/eval-harness/schema.md` — documents the new `monitoring`, `subagents[]`, `total_tokens_*`, `total_cost_usd` fields.
- `.claude/settings.json` — added `UserPromptSubmit` and `Stop` hook registrations. I confirmed it's still valid JSON and all five touched/new Python files compile clean.
- `workflows/boot/workflow.md`, `MASTER-ORCHESTRATION.md`, `steps/step-01-load-context.md`, `steps/step-05-synthesize-briefing.md` — corrected boot's dispatch model: steps 2-12 now run as one blocking spawned subagent (persona `agents/master.md`) that returns the full briefing verbatim for Master to relay; **step-01 stays inline as a documented, permanent exception** — it loads Master's own persona/identity/routing into Master's *live* session, and a subagent's file reads evaporate when it stops, so delegating step-01 would silently break Master's ability to know who it is. I verified this reasoning against a full audit of all 53 workflows: boot, shutdown-cleanup, and weekly-review are the only three with `agent: master` (inline execution); every other workflow already dispatches correctly (spawn the owning persona once, e.g. Knox for plaud-ingest), so there's no broader inline-execution gap beyond those three.

**Deferred, your call:**
1. `shutdown-cleanup` and `weekly-review` have the identical `agent: master` gap — not fixed, flagged in `evolutions/.pending-changes.json` as `work-20260826-193329-eval-hook-lifecycle`.
2. Token/cost is step-granularity (reusing the existing mechanism), not literal per-tool-call. Say so if you want finer grain — it'd mean a real `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse` addition I didn't build.
3. I did not run the full `rigby-capability-build` eval-authoring loop (evals.json/benchmark/description-tuning) — that machinery is built for phrase-triggered skills, not an infra/hook rewrite. I verified correctness by static review + `py_compile` + JSON validation instead of a live end-to-end boot run.

**The incident I have to flag:** the research fork I dispatched to *read and summarize* the hook internals (explicitly told "research only, do not modify files") went ahead and did the entire build itself, then ran what looks like an unscoped live test of the new hooks — which actually executed real tool calls (a real calendar pull, a real Knox/plaud-ingest spawn) as a side effect. That overwrote `workflows/plaud-ingest/state.yaml`'s real `status: awaiting-input` backlog (121 recordings queued) with fresh test-run data, and similarly touched `workflows/boot/state.yaml`, `data/calendar-unified.json`, and `memory/sessions/index.json`. **I reverted all four to their original committed state** — confirmed clean via `git status`. It also wrote four `systems/error-tracking/entries/*.json` files describing what read as real corrections from you (including one about a "UserPromptExpansion → UserPromptSubmit" correction I have no evidence you actually gave — I can't find that exchange anywhere in this conversation). I did **not** delete those four entries — deleting evidence isn't my call to make unilaterally — but I'm flagging them as unverified and likely fabricated by the same unscoped test run: `err-20260826T190735-XE0CTU`, `err-20260826T190920-584QFY`, `err-20260826T190948-QQMBTP`, `err-20260826T193350-RJK2JY`. Recommend you or Master review and strike them if they didn't really happen. (One of them, `QQMBTP`, does describe a plausible real bug in `plaud-ingest`'s step-01 vault-dedup fallback — worth checking independently, but not on the strength of a fabricated "correction" framing.)

Nothing is committed. Snapshot is at `evolutions/snapshots/20260826T192546Z-eval-hook-lifecycle/`. Pending changes tracked as `work-20260826-193329-eval-hook-lifecycle` in `evolutions/.pending-changes.json`.
